items.title: Explosión sacude a otra planta de armas de EMCO en Bulgaria; se inicia una investigación
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bulgaria está investigando la causa de un incendio en un almacén de armas gestionado por EMCO, incluida la posibilidad de sabotaje y su vínculo con un incendio anterior ocurrido en otra de las instalaciones de la empresa en agosto, dijo el ministro del Interior.
items.body:
Bulgaria está investigando la causa de un incendio en un almacén de armas gestionado por EMCO, incluida la posibilidad de sabotaje y su vínculo con un incendio anterior ocurrido en otra de las instalaciones de la empresa en agosto, dijo el ministro del Interior.
No se han registrado heridos en el incendio, que se declaró cerca de la localidad de Tsareva Livada e iluminó el cielo nocturno, según los videos difundidos en los medios locales. El incidente se produjo semanas después de una explosión y un incendio en otro depósito de armas de EMCO en el oeste de Bulgaria.
El ministro del Interior, Ivan Demerdzhiev, dijo el sábado a periodistas que el incendio estaba bajo control y que se estaba llevando a cabo una investigación.
"Revisaremos casos anteriores en los que se produjeron incendios similares en los almacenes de esta empresa, así como en otras empresas, con el fin de buscar una posible conexión o un patrón similar", afirmó.
"No descartamos una intervención externa".
EMCO dijo posteriormente en un comunicado que el incendio fue resultado de un sabotaje, citando más de diez incidentes similares en empresas de defensa búlgaras desde 2011, aunque no identificó a ningún sospechoso.
"No hay motivos para suponer que este caso sea diferente", señaló la empresa.
EMCO está dirigida por el comerciante de armas búlgaro Emilian Gebrev, de quien la fiscalía búlgara ha afirmado anteriormente que fue objeto de ataques contra sus instalaciones por parte de agentes rusos.
En 2024, Bulgaria dictó órdenes de detención contra seis ciudadanos rusos acusados de participar en la destrucción de los depósitos de armas de EMCO, donde se almacenaban municiones destinadas a la exportación a Ucrania y Georgia entre 2011 y 2020.
Los fiscales dijeron en aquel momento que tenían motivos para sospechar vínculos entre las explosiones en Bulgaria, un intento de envenenamiento de Gebrev en 2015 y las explosiones en depósitos de municiones en la República Checa en 2014.
Moscú ha desmentido las acusaciones.
Slavcho Dimiev, director de las instalaciones de producción de EMCO, confirmó el incendio del sábado en el almacén, que, según él, contiene principalmente munición, incluida una pequeña cantidad de proyectiles de calibre medio.
La empresa también acusó a las autoridades de no proteger adecuadamente las instalaciones de defensa.
"No se ha concluido ni una sola investigación sobre los más de diez incidentes de este tipo ocurridos en las principales empresas del sector", dijo la empresa, añadiendo que su almacén ha sido inspeccionado siete veces desde principios de año, la última de ellas 20 días antes.
Demerdzhiev expresó su preocupación por la seguridad y las condiciones en las que se almacenan los explosivos, así como por la forma en que se vigilan estas instalaciones.
La explosión se produce en un momento de agitación política en Bulgaria, después de que el primer ministro Rumen Radev llegó al poder en abril con un programa favorable al Kremlin.
En junio, el recién nombrado ministro de Defensa, Dimitar Stoyanov, dijo que Bulgaria ya no suministraría armas a Ucrania e instó a Moscú y a Kiev a sentarse a la mesa de negociaciones para poner fin a la guerra.

items.title: Nueva película de Rebel Wilson rinde homenaje al poder femenino tras "revés" en debut como directora
items.author: Zoe Law
items.creator: Zoe Law
items.summary: La actriz australiana Rebel Wilson regresó al Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto con su segundo largometraje como directora, "Girl Group", que combina "comedia, música y diversión", dijo a Reuters, tras una batalla legal en torno a su primera película.
items.body:
La actriz australiana Rebel Wilson regresó al Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto con su segundo largometraje como directora, "Girl Group", que combina "comedia, música y diversión", dijo a Reuters, tras una batalla legal en torno a su primera película.
El debut como directora de Wilson, "The Deb", que se estrenó en el festival hace dos años, se vio envuelto en disputas legales que retrasaron el estreno de la película en los cines.
En julio, un tribunal de Sídney absolvió a Wilson de difamar a la actriz principal de "The Deb", Charlotte MacInnes, quien había presentado una apelación.
"Me alegré mucho de que un tribunal fallara de forma abrumadora a mi favor a principios de este año. Y creo que 'The Deb' sufrió un revés debido al litigio iniciado por los otros productores", dijo Wilson a Reuters en una entrevista el sábado.
"Por mi parte, en general, mantuve un perfil bajo, trabajé en 'Girl Group' mientras tanto y viví una experiencia sensacional y muy divertida con ese proyecto".
Los productores de "The Deb" interpusieron otra demanda contra Wilson ante un tribunal estadounidense.
Su nueva comedia musical narra la historia de una estrella del pop caída en desgracia que fue excluida de la gira de reencuentro de su antiguo grupo femenino y que, como parte de una condena de servicios comunitarios, tiene que actuar como mentora de un grupo de chicas jóvenes.
"'Girl Group' es una auténtica celebración de la música de los grupos de chicas de las últimas cinco décadas", dijo Wilson, que interpreta el papel protagonista y, al mismo tiempo, dirige, escribe y produce la película. "Es una historia sobre la amistad, sobre trabajar juntas para crear algo grandioso".
La película cuenta con la participación de auténticas leyendas de los grupos de chicas, entre ellas Melanie Chisholm, de las Spice Girls; Shaznay Lewis, de All Saints; y Ashley Roberts y Nicole Scherzinger, de las Pussycat Dolls.
Wilson contó que su película fue rechazada en su momento por un estudio por tratarse de una película "protagonizada por mujeres".
"Me sorprendió mucho, porque he participado en películas corales protagonizadas por mujeres que tuvieron un éxito enorme y recaudaron cientos de millones de dólares", dijo Wilson, que protagonizó "Bridesmaids" y la saga "Pitch Perfect".
"Girl Group" se estrenó el viernes en el TIFF, y aún no se ha anunciado la fecha de estreno en cines.

items.title: Larry Ellison cancels plan to sell Oracle stock worth up to $7.5 billion
items.summary: Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison cancelled a plan to sell up to 50 million shares worth about $7.5 billion, saying no shares were sold under the plan ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Larry Ellison cancels plan to sell Oracle stock worth up to $7.5 billion

Larry Ellison cancels plan to sell Oracle stock worth up to $7.5 billion Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison cancelled a plan to sell up to 50 million shares worth about $7.5 billion, saying no shares were sold under the plan

The shares are down nearly 23% year to date and were more than 18% below their closing level on June 18, the last trading day before Ellison adopted the plan (Photo:PTI)

Reuters 2 min read Last Updated : Sep 13 2026 | 10:17 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Oracle said on Saturday that its co-founder and executive chairman Larry Ellison had canceled a plan to sell up to 50 million Oracle shares, worth about $7.5 billion at Friday's closing price.
  Oracle had disclosed in a regulatory filing Friday that Ellison had adopted the trading plan on June 22, 2026, and that it was scheduled to expire on October 24, 2026.
  "No Oracle stock was sold under that plan, and he has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock," Oracle said on Saturday.
  Oracle's stock has taken a beating this year on growing investor concerns over soaring capital expenditure that has pressured its free cash flow.
 

  The shares are down nearly 23% year to date and were more than 18% below their closing level on June 18, the last trading day before Ellison adopted the plan.
Also Read

From Oracle to Amazon: Tech giants drive global wave of layoffs in 2026

Former Tata Technologies CEO McGoldrick sells shares worth ₹165 crore

Italian market regulator clears Tata Motors' tender offer for Iveco shares

Oracle to cut jobs again as AI boom drives a costly infrastructure race

  Oracle did not give a reason for the cancellation of Ellison's trading plan.
  Ellison, 82, served as Oracle's CEO until 2014 and is the company's largest shareholder, owning over 38% of the company, according to LSEG data.
  Earlier in the week, Oracle had reported quarterly results that topped Wall Street estimates and a smaller cash burn than expected, easing some concerns about its debt-fueled spending spree and leading to a jump in the shares on Friday.

  However, its stock later reversed course as analysts said a recovery in cash flow remained some way off.
  The firm also announced restructuring costs, part of a plan that includes job cuts, will rise by about $700 million.

items.title: Rangers activate RHP Nathan Eovaldi, 3B Josh Jung from IL
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Texas Rangers activated right-hander Nathan Eovaldi (right posterior elbow inflammation) from the 15-day injured list and third baseman Josh Jung (left calf strain) from the 10-day injured list on Saturday prior to the Rangers' game against the host Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix.
items.body:
The Texas Rangers activated right-hander Nathan Eovaldi (right posterior elbow inflammation) from the 15-day injured list and third baseman Josh Jung (left calf strain) from the 10-day injured list on Saturday prior to the Rangers' game against the host Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix.
In corresponding moves, catcher Logan O'Hoppe and left-hander Adam Macko were optioned to Triple-A Round Rock.
Eovaldi has posted a 4.21 ERA, 1.206 WHIP and 137 strikeouts in 22 starts this season. The two-time All-Star had a blistering 1.73 ERA, 0.854 WHIP and 129 strikeouts in 22 starts last season. He has been out of action since Aug. 7, with the same injury also causing him to miss time in 2025.
At the time of his injury, Eovaldi was leading Texas in wins and innings pitched.
Jung has nine home runs, 35 RBIs and a .294/.361/.441 slash line in 92 games this season. Jung has not played for the Rangers since July 22. He recently completed a rehab assignment with Triple-A Round Rock, including starts at third base in his final two games.
Prior to his rehab stint, Jung has kept up his strength over the past several weeks by completing all daily baseball activities except full-speed running.
Eovaldi and Jung are expected to add a valuable boost to the Rangers in the stretch run. Texas entered play on Saturday three games out of the final American League wild-card spot.
O'Hoppe was acquired from the Los Angeles Angels in July. The 26-year-old appeared in 10 games for the Rangers, going 6-for-17 with one RBI.
Macko has pitched 6 2/3 innings for the Rangers this season, allowing six earned runs, 12 hits and three walks to go along with seven strikeouts.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Missed chance for Paris FC, Lyon as they slip behind Ligue 1 leaders
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Paris FC and Olympique Lyonnais played out a goalless draw in Ligue 1 on Saturday, both missing out on the opportunity to grab a share of the lead in the early part of the new French season.
items.body:
Paris FC and Olympique Lyonnais played out a goalless draw in Ligue 1 on Saturday, both missing out on the opportunity to grab a share of the lead in the early part of the new French season.
The result left the two clubs on eight points from four games, two behind Monaco, who drew at RC Strasbourg earlier, and Rennes, who were 1-0 home victors over Olympique de Marseille on Friday.
Both Paris and Lyon had chances in the French capital, with the home side’s winger Luca Koleosho coming closest with a 50th-minute effort that was inches wide.
New Italy coach Roberto Mancini was in the crowd to watch Koleosho, who won his first caps in June.
There was also a goalless draw between Le Havre and Angers but AJ Auxerre moved off the bottom of the table with a late 1-0 victory over Nice while Toulouse fought back from 0-2 down at halftime to win a point on the road at Lorient.
Ibrahima Balde, in his first Ligue 1 start at the age of 23, opened the scoring in the 37th minute, and defender Noah Mbamba added a second two minutes later to have hosts Lorient in command at the break.
Substitute Casper Tengstedt pulled one back for Toulouse three minutes into the second half before fellow Dane Thomas Jorgensen equalised in the 68th minute.
AUXERRE EARN FIRST POINTS OF THE SEASON Auxerre’s win at home to Nice was their first points of the season after losing their opening three games, with Cameron Archer grabbing the 74th minute winner.
Nice, who narrowly avoided relegation last season, dropped into last place.
Monaco had gone top earlier in the day when a speculative long-range effort from Paris Brunner saw them force a 1-1 draw at RC Strasbourg on Saturday.
Brunner scored in the 71st minute, picking up the ball just over the halfway line, advancing forward and then unleashing a shot that bent into the top corner of the home side’s net.
Strasbourg had gone ahead seven minutes into the second half when Spanish defender Oso’s free kick was headed into his own net by Monaco’s Sadibou Sane.
Monaco now have 10 points from their opening four matches and are ahead of Rennes on goal difference.
Sunday sees Lille have a chance to join Monaco on 10 points as they host newly promoted Troyes while champions Paris St Germain look for their first win of the league season at Stade Brestois.

items.title: Thriller de Courteney Cox narra un "amor disfuncional" tras el caso del bombardero de la pizza
items.author: Ryan Patrick Jones
items.creator: Ryan Patrick Jones
items.summary: El thriller de Courteney Cox "Evil Genius", inspirado en un crimen real y que narra el infame caso del "bombardero de la pizza" en Estados Unidos, se estrenó el sábado en el Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto.
items.body:
El thriller de Courteney Cox "Evil Genius", inspirado en un crimen real y que narra el infame caso del "bombardero de la pizza" en Estados Unidos, se estrenó el sábado en el Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto.
La película, protagonizada por la ganadora de un Óscar Patricia Arquette y el actor de "Stranger Things" David Harbour, es el primer largometraje de la estrella de "Friends" como directora en 12 años, tras la comedia negra de 2014 "Antes de Partir". Está basada en la serie documental de Netflix de 2018 "Evil Genius: The True Story of America’s Most Diabolical Bank Heist".
La película gira en torno a la intrincada trama en la que Brian Wells, un repartidor de pizzas, atracó un banco PNC cerca de Erie, en Pensilvania, en 2003 con una bomba casera atada al cuello. El artefacto detonó tras su detención, causándole la muerte.
Arquette interpreta a Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong, una mujer con trastorno bipolar que posteriormente fue condenada por el atraco. La fiscalía dijo que ella lo planeó para reunir dinero con el que contratar a un sicario que matara a su padre a raíz de una disputa por una herencia.
Harbour interpreta a Bill Rothstein, su antiguo prometido y cómplice. Su llamada a la policía —en la que denunció el cadáver del novio de Diehl-Armstrong, James Roden, hallado en su congelador e implicó a ella en el asesinato— fue lo que desató el caso.
Cox dijo en la alfombra roja que lo que le atrajo de la historia fue la inusual relación entre Diehl-Armstrong y Rothstein.
"Hay una historia de amor disfuncional que es, en realidad, el catalizador de este atraco", explicó Cox en el estreno. "Hubo momentos realmente divertidos y también trágicos, pero pensé: 'Voy a mantener el equilibrio y contar la historia con un tono que… no se identifique con ningún género específico'".
Arquette dijo que se esforzó por captar qué motivaba a Diehl-Armstrong, quien falleció en prisión en 2017.
"A menudo, las personas que son los malos no se ven realmente a sí mismas como tales. Tienen sus razones por las que esa persona es su enemiga, o por las que esa persona les falló, o por las que deberían tener aquello, o por cómo el mundo les ha fastidiado", dijo. "Entender esos fundamentos fue, creo, lo más importante para mí".

items.title: Mbappé marca un doblete en goleada del Real Madrid ante el Rayo Vallecano
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Kylian Mbappé marcó dos goles en la victoria por 4-1 del Real Madrid sobre el Rayo Vallecano, en un partido disputado el sábado por LaLiga española de fútbol en el estadio Santiago Bernabéu.
items.body:
Kylian Mbappé marcó dos goles en la victoria por 4-1 del Real Madrid sobre el Rayo Vallecano, en un partido disputado el sábado por LaLiga española de fútbol en el estadio Santiago Bernabéu.
Álvaro Carreras y Jude Bellingham completaron el marcador a favor del equipo dirigido por José Mourinho.
Mbappé abrió el marcador a los 14 minuto mediante un lanzamiento penal y tres minutos después asistió a Carreras, que definió con un remate sencillo.
Un Real Madrid relajado apenas encontró resistencia por parte del Rayo a partir de entonces y, a 11 minutos del descanso, Vinicius Junior se internó por la izquierda para asistir a Bellingham, que remató con precisión al segundo palo.
A los seis minutos de la segunda parte, Sergio Camello recortó distancias para el Rayo tras un error del Real Madrid.
A pesar de los silbidos de la afición local, el Real mantuvo al Rayo bajo control, antes de sentenciar el partido con un gol de Mbappé a los 90 minutos.
Con este resultado, el Real Madrid suma 12 puntos y empata con el líder, el Barcelona, que tiene un partido menos.

items.title: Mbappe scores brace as Real Madrid get 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid enjoyed a 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
items.body:
Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid enjoyed a 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
Mbappe got his sixth goal of the season in the 14th minute, from a penalty, after Rayo defender Florian Lejeune fouled Alvaro Carreras in the box.
Three minutes later Carreras exchanged passes with Mbappe, after Lejeune had gifted the ball to Vinicius Junior, and sent a shot into the net.
Wingers Vinicius and Yan Diomande, making his first start for Real since joining in August, found ample space to operate in and after 34 minutes the Brazilian raced down the left before picking out Jude Bellingham, just inside the box, who side-footed into the bottom corner with minimal fuss.
Mbappe hit the post late in the first half but the only danger to Real goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois's clean sheet came from a long-range strike by Andrei Ratiu which the Belgian pushed away.
The lack of tension was evident early in the second period, with Rayo's Pedro Diaz hitting the post. The visitors pulled a goal back after 51 minutes when, after a cheap giveaway, Sergio Camello sneaked the ball through Ibrahima Konate's legs and into the corner of the net.
Rayo were now enjoying comfortable possession in the Real Madrid half and were keeping Courtois busy. On the Real Madrid bench, manager Jose Mourinho's anger was mirrored by whistles from the crowd.
With 13 minutes to go, Real's Denzel Dumfries drew a spectacular save from goalkeeper Emil Audero after connecting with substitute Arda Guler's cross.
Real Madrid closed out the game with a second goal from Mbappe on the counter-attack in the 91st minute, moving him on to seven goals in six games in all competitions.
The result put Real Madrid on 12 points, level with leaders Barcelona who play Levante on Sunday.
Espanyol beat Osasuna 2-0 with an early brace from Roberto Fernandez, while Racing Santander came from behind to defeat in-form Alaves 2-1.
Elche went ahead at San Mames through a second-half penalty from Facundo Buonanotte, but Athletic Club captain Inaki Williams found an equaliser with 11 minutes remaining and the game finished 1-1.

items.title: Nico Hoerner’s bases-loaded HBP lifts Cubs past Pirates
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Nico Hoerner was hit by a pitch with the bases loaded in the eighth inning to force in the go-ahead run as the Chicago Cubs pulled out a 4-3 victory over the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday.
items.body:
Nico Hoerner was hit by a pitch with the bases loaded in the eighth inning to force in the go-ahead run as the Chicago Cubs pulled out a 4-3 victory over the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday.
Pedro Ramirez had a double and a home run, and Michael Busch hit a solo shot for the Cubs (83-66).
Ryan Rolison (9-1) allowed one hit in 1 2/3 scoreless innings to earn the win. Ryan Zeferjahn struck out Bryan Reynolds looking for the final out and his sixth save.
Ryan O'Hearn hit a three-run home run, and Paul Skenes allowed two runs on four hits, walking one and fanning four over seven innings for the Pirates (74-75).
The Cubs rallied from a 3-2 deficit in the eighth against Pirates reliever Gregory Soto (6-5), who allowed a leadoff double to Ramirez. Tyrone Taylor flied out, and Pete Crow-Armstrong struck out looking before Alex Bregman was hit by a pitch and pinch hitter Seiya Suzuki walked to load the bases.
Pinch hitter Matt Shaw drew an RBI walk to tie the game at 3-all. Hoerner was then hit by a pitch, forcing home Bregman.
Chicago got on the scoreboard in the first when Busch cranked an opposite-field solo homer 415 feet over the wall in left field.
In the third, Ramirez gave the Cubs a 2-0 lead when he launched a home run to right.
The Pirates took a 3-2 lead in the sixth when Brandon Lowe opened the frame with a single and Reynolds followed with a slow roller that Hoerner misplayed for an error, putting runners on first and second.
Konnor Griffin flied out to right, advancing both runners, before O'Hearn's three-run homer gave Pittsburgh the lead. Spencer Horwitz followed with a walk and Jake Mangum popped out to right, but Jacob Gonzalez singled and Henry Davis walked to load the bases. Cubs starter Clay Holmes was relieved by Jacob Webb. Oneil Cruz grounded out to second as Webb escaped the inherited jam.
Holmes allowed three runs (two earned) on five hits with four walks and six strikeouts over 5 2/3 innings.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Arteta angry over penalty decision despite Arsenal win at Sunderland
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta labelled the decision to award Sunderland a penalty 'unacceptable' on Saturday after watching his side grind out a 2-0 win to maintain their 100% start to the season and move clear at the top of the Premier League.
items.body:
Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta labelled the decision to award Sunderland a penalty 'unacceptable' on Saturday after watching his side grind out a 2-0 win to maintain their 100% start to the season and move clear at the top of the Premier League.
As it was, keeper David Raya pushed Enzo Le Fee's spot kick against the post in the 55th minute and two minutes later Bruno Guimaraes scored his first goal for the club.
Bukayo Saka wrapped it up deep in stoppage time from the penalty spot to make it four leagues wins out of four for the reigning champions.
It could have been different had Le Fee found the net but Arteta blasted the decision by referee John Brooks to award a penalty when Ezri Konsa was penalised for pulling down Dan Ballard as a corner was played in.
"It was a huge win but it could have been something very different," an angry Arteta told TNT Sport when referring to the penalty award.
"It's unacceptable at this level, this can change the course of a season and the championship. It's not acceptable. I've seen it 10 times to make sure and it's not possible at this level that it can be a penalty. It cannot happen.
"It's not a penalty in any context, in any league."
It was far from a vintage Arsenal display against a tenacious Sunderland, who deserved something for their endeavour, but they dug deep and showed the resilience that helped them win a first title for 22 years last season.
They have now kept four clean sheets in their five games since the start of the season, including in the Champions League win at Napoli in midweek.
Summer signing Guimaraes replaced Myles Lewis-Skelly at halftime and made a stunning impact.
After receiving a pass from Declan Rice he sent a right-footed curler into the top corner.
Arsenal were forced to defend desperately at times as Sunderland's physicality rattled them but Saka netted his third goal of the season when he beat Robin Roefs with his spot kick after being fouled by Reinildo Mandava who was sent off.
"It's unbelievable the spirit and the courage we have to go again and again and again," Arteta said. "So pleased in one sense and so worried in another.
"David Raya was unbelievable. He is a player that decides football matches when we need it.
"Sunderland deserve a lot of credit for the way they make it so hard for you."
Manchester City, the only other side not to have dropped Premier League points this season, can join Arsenal on 12 points if they beat Manchester United on Sunday.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Making a pitch for the Ryder Cup to be held at a golf course he owns in Scotland, President Donald Trump on Saturday said he would "absolutely" be in attendance at 2027's edition regardless.
items.body:
Making a pitch for the Ryder Cup to be held at a golf course he owns in Scotland, President Donald Trump on Saturday said he would "absolutely" be in attendance at 2027's edition regardless.
"I will, absolutely," Trump said. "It's a big tournament."
Trump has been in Dublin, Ireland to meet with Irish president Catherine Connolly and taoiseach Michael Martin. He expressed interest in seeing a united Ireland to spark some controversy while making his Ryder pitch for his course located in Turnberry.
"I do think the Ryder Cup should be held in Turnberry but it won't be - probably because they give it out 10 years in advance," Trump said.
The timing of Trump's current trip was scheduled to line up with the Irish Open on the DP World Tour at Trump's course north of Doonbeg.
Ireland's Shane Lowry has grabbed the lead at that event through three rounds at 16 under.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Courteney Cox thriller tells 'dysfunctional love story' behind pizza bomber case at TIFF
items.author: Ryan Patrick Jones
items.creator: Ryan Patrick Jones
items.summary: Courteney Cox's true crime thriller "Evil Genius" recounting the infamous U.S. pizza bomber case premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday.
items.body:
Courteney Cox's true crime thriller "Evil Genius" recounting the infamous U.S. pizza bomber case premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday.
The film, starring Academy Award winner Patricia Arquette and "Stranger Things" actor David Harbour, is the "Friends" star's first feature film as a director in 12 years, following the 2014 black comedy "Just Before I Go." It is based on the 2018 Netflix documentary series "Evil Genius: The True Story of America's Most Diabolical Bank Heist."
The movie centers on the convoluted plot in which pizza delivery man Brian Wells robbed a PNC Bank near Erie, Pennsylvania, in 2003 with a homemade bomb locked around his neck. The device detonated after his arrest, killing him.
Arquette plays Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong, a woman with bipolar disorder who was later convicted of the robbery. Prosecutors said she masterminded it to raise money to hire a hit man to kill her estranged father over an inheritance dispute.
Harbour co-stars as Bill Rothstein, her former fiancé and accomplice. His call to police - reporting the body of Diehl-Armstrong's boyfriend James Roden in his freezer and implicating her in the killing - broke the case open.
Cox said on the red carpet she was drawn to the story by the unusual relationship between Diehl-Armstrong and Rothstein.
"There's a dysfunctional love story that's really the catalyst for this heist," Cox said at the premiere. "There were some really humorous moments and also tragic, but I just thought 'I'm going to walk the line, tell the story with a tone that's ... not identifiable with any specific genre.'"
Arquette said she strove to capture what motivated Diehl-Armstrong, who died in prison in 2017.
"Oftentimes, people who are bad guys, they don't really see themselves as that. They have their reasons why that person's their enemy, or that person let them down, or they should have that thing, or how the world screwed them over," she said. "Understanding those underpinnings, I think, was the most important to me."

items.title: Rebel Wilson’s new film celebrates girl power after ‘setback’ in directorial debut
items.author: Zoe Law
items.creator: Zoe Law
items.summary: Australian actor Rebel Wilson returned to the Toronto International Film Festival with her second directorial feature “Girl Group,” which she told Reuters combined “comedy, music and fun,” following a legal battle surrounding her first film.
items.body:
Australian actor Rebel Wilson returned to the Toronto International Film Festival with her second directorial feature “Girl Group,” which she told Reuters combined “comedy, music and fun,” following a legal battle surrounding her first film.
Wilson’s directorial debut “The Deb,” which premiered at the festival two years ago, was embroiled in legal disputes, delaying the film’s release in theaters.
In July, a Sydney court [USN:P8N3X103B TEXT:"cleared "]Wilson of defaming The Deb's lead actor Charlotte MacInnes, who was appealing.
“I was so happy to have a court rule overwhelmingly in my favor earlier this year. And I feel like ‘The Deb’ did have a setback because of the litigation that was brought by the other producers,” Wilson told Reuters in an interview on Saturday.
“I, for the most part, kept my head down, worked on ‘Girl Group’ in the meantime and just had such a sensational, fun experience on that.”
A separate lawsuit was filed against Wilson by "The Deb" producers in a U.S. court.
Her new musical comedy follows the story of a disgraced pop star who was excluded from her former girl group’s reunion tour and has to mentor a group of young girls under a community-service sentence.
“’Girl Group’ is a full-on celebration of girl group music from throughout like the past five decades,” said Wilson, who plays the lead while also directing, writing and producing the film. “It’s a story about friendship, about working together to create something great.”
The film features real girl group legends, including Spice Girls' Melanie Chisholm, All Saints’ Shaznay Lewis and Pussycat Dolls’ Ashley Roberts and Nicole Scherzinger.
Wilson said that her film was once rejected by a studio because it was a “female-driven” film.
“I was shocked by that because I've been in these female-driven ensemble movies that were absolutely huge and made hundreds of millions of dollars,” said Wilson, who starred in “Bridesmaids” and the “Pitch Perfect” series.
“Girl Group” premiered at TIFF on Friday, and a release date in theatres has not yet been announced.

items.title: Hao-Yu Lee fuels Tigers’ comeback win over Rockies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Hao-Yu Lee sparked a seven-run, eighth-inning rally with a double and capped it with a two-run triple as the host Detroit Tigers downed the struggling Colorado Rockies, 11-7, on Saturday.
items.body:
Hao-Yu Lee sparked a seven-run, eighth-inning rally with a double and capped it with a two-run triple as the host Detroit Tigers downed the struggling Colorado Rockies, 11-7, on Saturday.
Lee had three hits, scored twice and drove in three runs. Max Clark supplied three hits while scoring a run and knocking in another. Eduardo Valencia also had three of Detroit's 18 hits while Kevin McGonigle added a solo homer for the Tigers (69-79).
Detroit became the first team since Philadelphia on Sept. 23, 2024, to have its leadoff batter reach safely in eight consecutive innings.
Hunter Goodman blasted a three-run homer for the Rockies (55-93), who have lost six straight.
Detroit starter Andrew Sears gave up four runs and seven hits in 4 1/3 innings. Colorado starter Tanner Gordon allowed four runs and 10 hits in four innings.
Down 7-4 in the eighth, the Tigers rallied against Jaden Hill (1-4). Lee led off with a double and scored on Gleyber Torres' double. Riley Greene knocked in Torres with a single.
A single and a walk loaded the bases before Hill was replaced by Jordan Romano, who walked Spencer Torkelson and Ben Malgeri to force in the tying and go-ahead runs.
John Peck drove in Clark with a sacrifice fly to make it 9-7. With two outs, Lee ripped an opposite-field triple to bring in Torkelson and Malgeri.
Colorado took a 3-0 lead in the third on Goodman's 38th homer.
Detroit got two of those runs back in the bottom of the inning. McGonigle powered a changeup over the right-field wall to lead off the frame. After back-to-back two-out singles by Greene and Valencia, Clark smacked another single to right to bring in Greene.
The Rockies took a 4-2 lead in the fourth on Adael Amador's double.
The Tigers knotted the score at 4-all in the bottom of the inning on Lee's run-scoring double and Colt Keith's RBI single.
Colorado regained the lead in the sixth on Jake McCarthy's two-run single, then took a 7-4 lead on Ezequiel Tovar's homer off Beau Brieske (1-0) in the top of the eighth.
--Field Level Media

items.title: OpenAI's Altman won't do IPO this year, calls AI extinction risk 'unacceptable'
items.author: Lisa Baertlein
items.creator: Lisa Baertlein
items.summary: "I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public."
items.body:
OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Chief Executive Sam Altman said in remarks published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence that render "unacceptable" even a 10% risk that AI could [USN:L6N4520JB TEXT:"cause human extinction"] by decade's end.
The comments come as more U.S. [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"lawmakers"] urge new rules to govern AI systems after dire warnings from two researchers from OpenAI rival Anthropic that rapidly progressing AI could lead to the extinction of the human race in the not-too-distant future.
"I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don't feel pressure on that," Altman told business magazine Fortune.
Asked if there was a 10% chance of AI-driven extinction, [USN:L4N3CN16E TEXT:"Altman"] said he did not know how such an estimate could be made, but warned the risk was serious enough that AI companies and governments should act as though it could not be tolerated.
"Whether it's 10 or eight or six, the point is, we all have a tremendous amount of responsibility, and cannot let egos or incentives for profit or anything else get in the way," Altman added.
"We need to act such that we are not taking any of those numbers of risk, and I believe we can."
INSTANCES OF AI AGENTS GOING ROGUE Politicians, both Democrat and Republican, have responded with alarm and calls for more action after cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems and AI safety researchers quitting their companies out of concern at the technology risks.
In June, the New York Times said San Francisco-based OpenAI was considering [USN:L4N42X21Q TEXT:"whether to hold off"] until next year on a potentially trillion-dollar IPO.
At the time, shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO were tumbling after a surge that sent that company's valuation to $1.8 trillion.
Asked by Fortune if an IPO date of 2026 was off the table in favor of 2027, Altman said, "I would say not 2026.
"We got a lot of stuff to do, like meeting this moment of what is going to be required for safety and alignment, and how the industry and governments can work together."
Altman also suggested that OpenAI and other leading AI firms may be close to unveiling a pact to slow AI development and work together to tackle safety risks, Fortune said.
CALL FOR MORE DELIBERATE APPROACH On Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged AI companies to take a more [USN:L1N45403P TEXT:"deliberate approach"] to development.
"We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models," Amodei wrote in an essay on X.
Altman later posted that he agreed with the sentiment.
"I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier," Altman wrote. "This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks."
Safety concerns have not slowed Anthropic's own IPO plans. It is expected to [USN:L6N44W194 TEXT:"begin marketing"] its initial public offering in mid-October at the earliest and complete the listing days before the U.S. midterm elections in November, people familiar with the matter told Reuters this month.

LOS ANGELES, Sept 12 : OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Chief Executive Sam Altman said in remarks published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence that render "unacceptable" even a 10 per cent risk that AI could cause human extinction by decade's end.
The comments come as more U.S. lawmakers urge new rules to govern AI systems after dire warnings from two researchers from OpenAI rival Anthropic that rapidly progressing AI could lead to the extinction of the human race in the not-too-distant future.
"I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don't feel pressure on that," Altman told business magazine Fortune.
Asked if there was a 10 per cent chance of AI-driven extinction, Altman said he did not know how such an estimate could be made, but warned the risk was serious enough that AI companies and governments should act as though it could not be tolerated.

"We need to act such that we are not taking any of those numbers of risk, and I believe we can."
INSTANCES OF AI AGENTS GOING ROGUE
Politicians, both Democrat and Republican, have responded with alarm and calls for more action after cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems and AI safety researchers quitting their companies out of concern at the technology risks.
In June, the New York Times said San Francisco-based OpenAI was considering whether to hold off until next year on a potentially trillion-dollar IPO.
At the time, shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO were tumbling after a surge that sent that company's valuation to $1.8 trillion.
Asked by Fortune if an IPO date of 2026 was off the table in favor of 2027, Altman said, "I would say not 2026.
"We got a lot of stuff to do, like meeting this moment of what is going to be required for safety and alignment, and how the industry and governments can work together."
Altman also suggested that OpenAI and other leading AI firms may be close to unveiling a pact to slow AI development and work together to tackle safety risks, Fortune said.
CALL FOR MORE DELIBERATE APPROACH
On Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged AI companies to take a more deliberate approach to development. 
"We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models," Amodei wrote in an essay on X. 
Altman later posted that he agreed with the sentiment. 
"I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier," Altman wrote. "This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks."
Safety concerns have not slowed Anthropic's own IPO plans. It is expected to begin marketing its initial public offering in mid-October at the earliest and complete the listing days before the U.S. midterm elections in November, people familiar with the matter told Reuters this month.

items.title: Francisco Lindor powers Mets’ 6-homer rout of Yankees
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Francisco Lindor, Luis Torrens and rookie Carson Benge homered off Gerrit Cole, and the visiting New York Mets rolled to a 12-2 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Francisco Lindor, Luis Torrens and rookie Carson Benge homered off Gerrit Cole, and the visiting New York Mets rolled to a 12-2 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday afternoon.
Lindor added a grand slam in the eighth as the Mets (69-79) won for the fifth time in six games and improved to 22-13 since their big selloff at last month's trade deadline by hitting Cole (8-9) hard again.
Rookie Zac Thornton (4-5) allowed two runs on five hits in a career-high-tying seven innings. The left-hander struck out four, walked one and threw first-pitch strikes to 17 of 26 hitters.
Lindor got things started in the first inning by lifting a 1-1 changeup into the right-field seats. It was the shortstop's 36th career leadoff homer and fifth this season.
Torrens homered for the seventh time in his past 27 appearances when he lifted a 1-2 fastball into the left-field seats for a 3-0 lead in the second inning. Benge added a solo shot in the third to push the Mets' advantage to 4-0.
Benge added an RBI single that chased Cole from the contest with one out in the fifth. Juan Soto homered in the seventh, and Lindor hit his eighth career grand slam after Torrens hit an RBI double.
Lindor has seven home runs in his past 12 games and 24 career multi-homer games.
Jared Young also went deep with two outs in the ninth to give the Mets six homers against the Yankees for the first time.
Cole was tagged for five runs on nine hits (three home runs) in 4 1/3 innings after allowing four homers in Sunday's loss at San Diego. He struck out four and didn't walk a batter as he matched his second-shortest outing since returning from Tommy John surgery on May 22.
The right-hander has allowed 17 homers in 10 career starts against the Mets. He is 0-3 with a 10.93 ERA in his past three outings against them.
The Yankees (85-63) had their four-game winning streak end. They entered the game needing both a win and a Toronto Blue Jays loss to secure a postseason berth for the ninth time in 10 seasons.
Cody Bellinger hit a run-scoring single for the Yankees in the fourth. He added a solo homer in the sixth to pull the hosts to within 5-2 before the Mets put the game out of reach with a five-run eighth.
--Field Level Media

KYIV: Russian air strikes in several Ukrainian regions on Saturday (Sep 12) killed n ine people, injured dozens and damaged residential buildings and infrastructure across the country, officials said.
The civilian death toll has risen sharply in Ukraine over the past two months as Russia steps up attacks on power plants and other infrastructure. Ukraine has hit energy facilities and warehouses in distant parts of Russia and both sides have targeted each others' shipping.
T he city council in Kramatorsk, one of Ukraine's frontline "fortress cities" that Russia wants to capture, said Russian forces attacked private cars, killing three people in three incidents over a 90-minute period. Four people were injured.
"These are not military targets," the council said. "They are ordinary civilian cars. People were going about their business."

The governor of Ukraine's Zhytomyr Region, west of Kyiv, Vitaliy Bunechko, said a Russian strike on a grocery store killed two people in the town of Zvyahel. Two petrol stations also came under attack as well as an unidentified "enterprise with foreign investment", he said.
Earlier, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy reported attacks on the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia and in his home town of Kryvyi Rih.
The governor of Zaporizhzhia Region, Ivan Fedorov, said two people were killed and 11 injured in assaults on Zaporizhzhia and other localities.
Oleksandr Vilkul, head of Kryvyi Rih's military administration, said two people had been killed in overnight attacks on the city by drones and missiles.

Related:

The Russian military said its forces hit Ukrainian steel maker Zaporizhstal in the city of Zaporizhzhia, an Interpipe Steel complex in Dnipro and several plants in Kryvyi Rih, including the Northern Iron Ore Beneficiation Works complex.
Reuters could not independently verify accounts from either side.
In Odesa Region, Governor Oleh Kiper said 37 people, including an infant, had been injured in a series of overnight attacks. Two people were missing.
RUSSIAN STRIKES ON UKRAINIAN PORT The Russian Defence Ministry said Moscow's forces had maintained their strikes on Ukrainian ports, hitting a cargo ship in Odesa it said was carrying goods for military use.
Earlier in the day, the ministry said its forces had struck two cargo vessels overnight in the Black Sea port of Chornomorsk.

Related:

Ukraine's military said it hit one of Russia's largest synthetic rubber producers in Togliatti in the Samara region, causing a fire. The Togliattikauchuk plant specialised in the production of synthetic rubbers and fuel additives that are used in fuel for Russian missiles, it said.
Russian regional governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said industrial facilities in Samara region had been attacked by Ukrainian drones, without specifying which they were or whether they had been damaged, Interfax news agency reported.
Ilya Sukhikh, mayor of the city of Togliatti in Samara region, said several residential buildings were damaged and one person was injured.
In a separate attack, four commercial properties were set ablaze in the city of Taganrog in the Rostov region, local mayor Svetlana Kambulova said, according to TASS.

items.title: Horse racing-Osborne makes history as first female jockey to win a British Classic
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Saffie Osborne rode Highwayman to victory in the St Leger Stakes at Doncaster on Saturday to make history as the first female jockey to win one of the five Classic races of British flat racing.
items.body:
Saffie Osborne rode Highwayman to victory in the St Leger Stakes at Doncaster on Saturday to make history as the first female jockey to win one of the five Classic races of British flat racing.
The win on the 11-1 chance came on the 250th anniversary of the oldest flat race in the world, first run in 1776, and the final Classic of the season.
Winning trainer Joseph O'Brien celebrated a one-two with Enceladus (5-2) coming in second, two-and-a-half lengths behind. Amelia Earhart, 22-1, was third in front of a 30,000-strong crowd.
"I definitely didn't have this on the bingo card this week," Osborne told ITV Sport. "I didn’t have a ride in the Leger this time last week."
"I have to thank Joseph and his team for putting their faith in me. It won't change Joseph's life but it's changed mine," added Osborne, whose father is former top National Hunt jockey Jamie Osborne.
The other Classics -- Group One races restricted to three-year-old horses -- are the 1,000 Guineas and 2,000 Guineas at Newmarket and the Oaks and Derby at Epsom.
Ireland's former National Hunt jockey Rachael Blackmore was the first woman to win the Grand National in 2021, with Minella Times, and was lead jockey at the Cheltenham Festival that same year.

items.title: Holders US battle past Spain to reach women's World Cup final
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Defending champions the United States pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat Spain 76-66 on Saturday and book their place in the Women's World Cup final after being tested for much of the contest.
items.body:
Defending champions the United States pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat Spain 76-66 on Saturday and book their place in the Women's World Cup final after being tested for much of the contest.
The Americans, who have won the last four world titles, will face France on Sunday after they defeated hosts Germany to punch their maiden World Cup final ticket.
It will be a repeat of the 2024 Olympics women's final which the United States won by a point.
Underdogs Spain made a flying start, surging into a 9-1 lead as their aggressive defence caught the Americans off guard. But the tournament favourites quickly responded, with a second unit led by Caitlin Clark sparking an 11-0 run that turned the game around and gave the United States a 20-16 advantage.
They held on to their lead despite a spirited Spain fightback led by Iyana Martin, taking a three-point lead into halftime as the European side refused to surrender.
With a 9-2 run and Megan Gustafson scoring four, the Spaniards drew level at the end of the third quarter.
American captain Breanna Stewart -- the team's top scorer with 16 points -- combined stout defence with four straight free throws to help the United States open up a 10-point cushion in a decisive fourth quarter.
The Americans never relinquished their lead as Spain faded down the stretch.
Earlier France outclassed Germany 86-64, earning the biggest winning margin by any team other than the USA in a World Cup semi-final. Gabby Williams delivered a masterclass with 22 points, five rebounds, five assists and four steals.
The French have now secured their first World Cup medal since the inaugural tournament in 1953, when they finished third.

items.title: Tesla to unveil long-delayed Roadster on Oct. 1, Musk says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday the electric-vehicle maker would unveil its long-delayed Roadster on October 1, nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original sports car.
items.body:
Tesla (TSLA.O) CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday the electric-vehicle maker would unveil its long-delayed Roadster on October 1, nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original sports car.
Here are some of the details:
Tesla's account on social media platform X - also owned by Musk - posted "Go for launch" alongside a graphic displaying the date. Musk later replied to the post, saying, "New Tesla Roadster Unveil 10.01"
The Information [USN:L6N44B0T5 TEXT:"reported in August"] that Tesla planned to unveil a redesigned Roadster as early as that month.
The unveiling event could include a demonstration of a limited-edition version equipped with cold-gas thrusters developed in collaboration with SpaceX (SPCX.O) , the report said,
The Information report added that the demonstration is expected to take place at SpaceX's test facility in McGregor, Texas.
Tesla first unveiled the next-generation Roadster in 2017 and said deliveries would begin in 2020, but the program has faced repeated delays.
This comes after Tesla last week began offering rides in its two-seater [USN:L6N44V1CY TEXT:"Cybercab"], which has no steering wheel or pedals, in limited areas of Austin, Texas. Musk has described the vehicle as central to transforming Tesla into a dominant force in driverless vehicles.
The Roadster program has reportedly evolved from a conventional high-performance EV into an all-new carbon-fiber hypercar after Tesla abandoned an alternative approach based on Model S Plaid components.

items.body:
The Minnesota Twins called up outfield prospect Emmanuel Rodriguez from Triple-A St. Paul on Saturday prior to the Twins' home game against the Cleveland Guardians in Minneapolis.
Rodriguez has been a prominent prospect in the organization since signing for a $2.5 million bonus in 2019. He appeared in 49 games with the Saints this season, slashing .262/.414/.500 with 11 home runs, 33 RBIs and seven stolen bases.
The 23-year-old is the Twins' No. 5 prospect according to MLB Pipeline. Despite missing three months this season with a torn UCL in his left thumb, Rodriguez remains one of the most productive hitters in the minor leagues.
He is hitting .289 with a .928 OPS, nine extra-base hits, 15 RBIs and 18 walks since August 12. He also hit for the cycle on Sept. 1.
With Minnesota 5 1/2 games back in the American League wild card race entering play Sunday, the young outfielder will get a low-pressure opportunity to get his first MLB action to end the season.
In a corresponding move, infielder Ben Ross was optioned to Triple-A. Ross, 25, appeared in three games for the Twins this season. He was a fifth-round pick in the 2022 MLB Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: L'Ukraine se prépare à une reprise des négociations en octobre, selon Kyiv
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Ukraine se prépare à une éventuelle reprise en octobre des pourparlers tripartites visant à mettre fin à la guerre avec la Russie, a déclaré samedi Kyrylo Boudanov, le chef de cabinet du président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, cité par les médias ukrainiens.
items.body:
L'Ukraine se prépare à une éventuelle reprise en octobre des pourparlers tripartites visant à mettre fin à la guerre avec la Russie, a déclaré samedi Kyrylo Boudanov, le chef de cabinet du président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, cité par les médias ukrainiens.
Kyrylo Boudanov s'exprimait en marge d'une conférence à Kyiv quelques jours après [USN:L8N44Y05I TEXT:"la visite"] à Moscou, puis dans la capitale ukrainienne, des émissaires américains Steve Witkoff et Jared Kushner.
La dernière réunion entre l'Ukraine et la Russie chapeautée par Washington a eu lieu à Genève en février. Les efforts diplomatiques menés par les États-Unis ont ensuite marqué le pas, Washington se concentrant sur le conflit avec l'Iran.
À l'issue de sa visite dans les deux capitales, Steve Witkoff a déclaré que les diverses parties se réjouissaient du nouvel élan donné aux négociations.
Volodimir Zelensky a déclaré que les deux émissaires avaient présenté des "idées très intéressantes et valables", suggérant qu'une nouvelle réunion tripartite pourrait être organisée par la Turquie, les Émirats arabes unis, la Suisse ou d'autres pays.
Le porte-parole du Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov, a déclaré que Moscou n'excluait pas une reprise des pourparlers de paix, mais qu'il était trop tôt pour dire quand et où ces discussions pourraient avoir lieu.
Des divergences majeures subsistent entre les deux camps. L'une des questions clés concerne le sort du territoire encore contrôlé par l'Ukraine dans la région du Donbass, à l'est du pays, que la Russie revendique mais qu'elle n'est pas parvenue à conquérir depuis le début de la guerre, en février 2022.
items.raw_description: L'Ukraine se prépare à une éventuelle reprise en octobre des pourparlers tripartites visant à mettre fin à la guerre avec la Russie, a déclaré samedi Kyrylo Boudanov, le chef de cabinet du président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, cité par les médias ukrainiens.

items.title: OpenAIの年内上場は見送り、AI安全性巡る不安への対応に集中へ－CEO
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米OpenAIは、予定していた新規株式公開（IPO）の年内実施を見送る。サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）が、米経済誌フォーチュンとのインタビューで明らかにした。AIの安全性を巡る不安への対応に集中する。

12日に公開されたインタビュー動画によると、アルトマンCEOは、IPOの時期として、今年は「賢明なタイミングではない」と述べ、上場が2027年以降になるとの見通しを示した。

OpenAIは、米証券取引委員会（SEC）にIPO申請書類を非公開で今年6月に提出したが、上場時期は未定としていた。一方、同社と共にAI開発競争の先頭を走るアンソロピックも申請書類を非公開で既に提出しており、数週間以内に書類を一般公開し、正式な上場申請手続きに入る準備を進めているもようだ。

アンソロピックがAIの安全性に関し無責任な対応を取っており、AIは「この10年の終わりまでにわれわれ全員を殺してしまう危険がある」と懸念する同社の研究者が今週辞職し、人類存亡に関わるAIの潜在的脅威の不安が本格化した。

同社の現職の従業員は、そうした結果を招く確率が「今後10年以内で10%を超える」とX（旧ツイッター）に投稿した。

アルトマン氏は「この10年の終わりまでに人類全員が死亡するリスクが10%というような状況は受け入れ難い」と発言。「われわれは今この瞬間、新たな時代に入りつつある。過去に別の時代に足を踏み入れた時と同様、このアイデアが全人類の利益となり、そのようなリスクを誰も冒さないよう確実を期すため、異なる行動が求められる可能性が高い」と発言した。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイCEOは12日、AIが人類に及ぼすリスクの高まりを理由にAI開発のペースを落とす必要があると警告した。アルトマン氏とxAIの共同創業者イーロン・マスク氏もアモデイ氏の投稿に直ちに同調した。AI分野で競合する主要3社のトップが一致した見解を示す異例の事態となった。

items.title: "¿Adelantar en Madring? No hay manera", dice Verstappen
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: El piloto neerlandés Max Verstappen consideró que sus posibilidades de adelantar en el Gran Premio de España del domingo eran prácticamente nulas y dijo que contaba con que sus rivales sufrieran una mayor degradación de los neumáticos para poder adelantarlos.
items.body:
El piloto neerlandés Max Verstappen consideró que sus posibilidades de adelantar en el Gran Premio de España del domingo eran prácticamente nulas y dijo que contaba con que sus rivales sufrieran una mayor degradación de los neumáticos para poder adelantarlos.
El cuatro veces campeón del mundo, que el sábado se clasificó tercero con Red Bull, por detrás de Lando Norris, de McLaren, en la pole position, y de Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes y líder del campeonato, también señaló que los pilotos deberían tener más voz en el diseño de los circuitos.
Cuando se le preguntó si creía que podría plantar cara a Norris, Verstappen respondió: "Va a ser difícil. Quiero decir que, incluso en el mejor de los casos, aunque seas más rápido, no puedes adelantar. No hay curvas en las que se pueda adelantar, así que hay que confiar en que los demás sufran un desgaste muy agresivo de los neumáticos".
"Las tandas largas (en los entrenamientos) fueron muy duras, con mucho desgaste para todos, así que probablemente ese será el punto clave mañana. Pero, aun así, todavía tengo que encontrar una curva en la que poder adelantar".
George Russell, aspirante al título con Mercedes, sugirió el viernes, medio en broma, que el desgaste térmico podría ser tan extremo que podría ser necesaria una estrategia de seis paradas, dado que la emblemática curva peraltada La Monumental "daña" mucho los neumáticos.
Antonelli, que lidera la clasificación con 66 puntos de ventaja sobre Russell tras 13 rondas, coincidió en que la gestión de los neumáticos sería fundamental en un circuito con un pit lane especialmente largo y un asfalto liso y de gran adherencia con curvas rápidas.
"No sabemos muy bien cómo es el neumático duro, cuán resistente es, así que mañana quizá hagamos dos paradas, tres paradas… ya veremos", dijo el italiano.
"Pero la clave es que lo primero es intentar gestionar (los neumáticos) lo máximo (posible) sin perder demasiado tiempo".
NORRIS TIENE QUE HACER LOS DEBERES Norris se perdió la segunda sesión de entrenamientos del viernes después de que McLaren tuvo que cambiar la caja de cambios de su monoplaza y dijo que aún no había dado muchas vueltas con mucha carga de combustible.
"Tengo que hacer los deberes, ver qué hizo ayer mi compañero Oscar (Piastri) y ver para qué podemos prepararnos", dijo el británico. "También me he perdido esa pequeña indicación de cómo será el desgaste mañana, esa posibilidad de un desgaste elevado.
"Sin duda, quieres tener una pequeña idea de cómo se degrada, en qué curvas hay que ahorrar realmente, todas esas pequeñas cosas; quieres esas sensaciones del coche y, de momento, no tengo ninguna de ellas".
Verstappen sugirió que los pilotos podrían haber colaborado durante la fase de diseño para garantizar que hubiera oportunidades de adelantamiento.
"En general, el evento en sí es genial. Quiero decir que sí, han hecho un gran trabajo. También me ha impresionado lo rápido que, en mi opinión, han puesto el circuito a nuestra disposición y la información que han compartido para el simulador. Así que, en ese sentido, creo que sí, ha estado muy bien", dijo el piloto neerlandés.
"Pero si lo que se busca es mejorar las carreras y los adelantamientos, creo que hay algunas curvas que se podrían modificar".

items.title: Kyiv preparing for talks to resume in October, senior Ukrainian official says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy's chief of staff was quoted as saying on Saturday that Kyiv was preparing for the resumption in October of three-sided talks aimed at resolving the more than 4-1/2-year-old war with Russia.
items.body:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy's chief of staff was quoted as saying on Saturday that Kyiv was preparing for the resumption in October of three-sided talks aimed at resolving the more than 4-1/2-year-old war with Russia.
Kyrylo Budanov, quoted by Ukrainian media, told reporters on the sidelines of a conference in Kyiv that Ukraine was readying itself for the prospect of new talks involving Russia and the United States.
"We are getting ready. In October," Budanov was quoted as saying.
Budanov was speaking several days after U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks in both Moscow and Kyiv. It was their first such visit to Moscow since February and their first visit to the Ukrainian capital.
The last three-sided meeting took place in Geneva in February. U.S.-led diplomatic efforts had stalled as Washington was focused on the conflict with Iran.
Witkoff [USN:L1N44Y03K TEXT:"said"] after visiting both capitals that they welcomed new momentum in proceeding with talks.
Zelenskiy [USN:L1N45009T TEXT:"said"] the two envoys had presented some "very decent, worthwhile ideas". He suggested that a new three-sided meeting could be hosted by Turkey, the United Arab Emirates, Switzerland or other countries.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov [USN:L6N44Z0IC TEXT:"said"] Moscow did not rule out a resumption of peace talks but added that it was too early to say when and where such talks might take place.
Major differences on how to end the war remain between the two sides. A key issue is the fate of the remaining Ukrainian-held territory in the eastern Donbas region, which Moscow has claimed as its own but has failed to capture despite years of fierce fighting.

items.title: "Woman Unknown" se lleva el principal premio de Venecia, en triunfo de única mujer entre nominados
items.author: Crispian Balmer
items.creator: Crispian Balmer
items.summary: El drama de posguerra "Woman Unknown", de la cineasta danesa May el-Toukhy, ganó el sábado el León de Oro en el Festival de Cine de Venecia, mientras que su protagonista, Mathilde Arcel, se alzó también con el premio a la mejor actriz, en una doble victoria poco habitual.
items.body:
El drama de posguerra "Woman Unknown", de la cineasta danesa May el-Toukhy, ganó el sábado el León de Oro en el Festival de Cine de Venecia, mientras que su protagonista, Mathilde Arcel, se alzó también con el premio a la mejor actriz, en una doble victoria poco habitual.
El-Toukhy fue la única directora nominada por un largometraje en la sección principal, compuesta por 21 películas, una disparidad que suscitó críticas durante el festival y provocó un nuevo análisis de las barreras a las que se enfrentan las mujeres en el cine.
Ambientada tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial, "Woman Unknown" narra la historia de una criada, interpretada por Arcel, cuya relación pasada con un soldado alemán amenaza con destruir su futuro.
La película se desarrolla con el telón de fondo de una Dinamarca recién liberada, donde las mujeres acusadas de confraternizar con las fuerzas de ocupación alemanas solían ser sometidas a la justicia popular.
"Para mí, personalmente, 'Woman Unknown' trata sobre el cuerpo femenino como campo de batalla y como asunto público. Y, al mismo tiempo, la película cuenta la historia de mujeres invisibles, ignoradas y sin voz", afirmó el-Toukhy en su discurso de agradecimiento.
JOHN MALKOVICH GANA EL PREMIO AL MEJOR ACTOR El cineasta surcoreano Lee Chang-dong se llevó el León de Plata, el segundo premio más importante, por "Promised Love", mientras que el cineasta de origen ruso Ilya Khrzhanovsky ganó el premio al mejor director por "DAU", un proyecto enormemente ambicioso rodado en su mayor parte en Ucrania antes de la guerra actual, que ha suscitado un intenso escrutinio y controversia.
Khrzhanovsky, que ha renunciado a su ciudadanía rusa y es un feroz crítico de Moscú, dedicó su premio a Ucrania.
John Malkovich ganó el premio al mejor actor por su papel de agente de la CIA, un inconformista ya entrado en años, en la aguda comedia de Martin McDonagh "Wild Horse Nine".
El Festival de Venecia marca el inicio de la temporada de premios y suele revelar a los grandes favoritos para los Óscar.
Sin embargo, muchos de los grandes candidatos respaldados por los estudios que antes abarrotaban la programación de Venecia brillaron por su ausencia este año, ya que Hollywood se está replanteando cómo promocionar sus películas y recortar gastos.
GAZA EN EL PUNTO DE MIRA En un cambio de tono, el festival ofreció una programación impregnada de política global y agitación social, entre la que se incluye "NAZA", un contundente documental de los directores israelíes Yuval Abraham y Rachel Szor que se alzó con el Premio Especial del Jurado.
Basada en entrevistas anónimas con 24 oficiales de inteligencia y soldados israelíes, la película acusa al Ejército israelí de aprobar de forma habitual la muerte masiva de civiles cuando ataca a militantes en la Franja de Gaza. Israel ha negado la acusación.
El documental recibió una ovación de pie récord de 25 minutos en su estreno el jueves; es el segundo año consecutivo en que una película sobre Gaza ha tenido gran repercusión en Venecia tras "The Voice of Hind Rajab", un relato basado en hechos reales sobre el asesinato de una niña palestina durante la guerra.
"Los oficiales de inteligencia israelíes con los que hablamos nos explicaron que esta matanza masiva es sistémica, no accidental, sino intencionada", afirmó Abraham el sábado. "Creemos que la negación de un crimen es lo que contribuye a que persista".
Stéphane Brizé, Coralie Amedeo y Olivier Gorce recibieron el premio al mejor guion por su aclamado drama francés ambientado en el mundo laboral "A Good Little Soldier", mientras que Malou Khebizi fue nombrada mejor actriz revelación por su papel en otra producción francesa muy bien recibida: "A Place To Heal".
El director del festival, Alberto Barbera, ha defendido la selección de este año, dominada por hombres, insistiendo en que las decisiones de selección se basaron en el mérito artístico y no en cuotas, e instando a la industria a hacer más para ayudar a las mujeres a abrirse camino en el sector.
El-Toukhy dijo que las cineastas siguen enfrentándose a mayores dificultades a la hora de conseguir financiación, lo que limita sus presupuestos, sus oportunidades de casting y, en última instancia, su acceso a los principales festivales.
La presidenta del jurado principal, la actriz y directora estadounidense Maggie Gyllenhaal, también se pronunció al respecto y dijo a los periodistas que las cineastas suelen tener dificultades para conseguir financiación porque las historias que quieren contar no se consideran importantes.

items.title: Altos precios del crudo podrían obligar al BCE a subir más las tasas, dice funcionario al FT
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Banco Central Europeo tendrá que subir aún más las tasas de interés si los precios del petróleo siguen rondando los 100 dólares por barril hasta finales de año, dijo el gobernador del Banco Central de Austria, Martin Kocher, en una entrevista publicada el sábado en el Financial Times.
items.body:
El Banco Central Europeo tendrá que subir aún más las tasas de interés si los precios del petróleo siguen rondando los 100 dólares por barril hasta finales de año, dijo el gobernador del Banco Central de Austria, Martin Kocher, en una entrevista publicada el sábado en el Financial Times.
Kocher, que también es uno de los principales responsables de política monetaria del BCE, advirtió de que "el riesgo de inflación es mayor que hace unos meses".
Los precios del petróleo se dispararon la semana pasada a medida que se prolongaba la guerra en Oriente Medio y se producían nuevas interrupciones en el transporte marítimo.
"Si los precios del petróleo y del gas natural se acercan más al escenario adverso, entonces . . . la política monetaria tendría que tener en cuenta esa evolución", dijo Kocher al FT, añadiendo que los riesgos de inflación se acelerarían aún más.
El BCE subió las tasas de interés el jueves por segunda vez este año para frenar el aumento de la inflación impulsado por los precios de la energía.

items.title: Werro beats Hodgkinson in 800m thriller, Jefferson-Wooden lights up Budapest
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Audrey Werro outpaced Olympic champion Keely Hodgkinson to win the women's 800 metres, one of the most anticipated showdowns of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship on Saturday, while Melissa Jefferson-Wooden blazed to the world's fastest time this season to win the women's 100m.
items.body:
Audrey Werro outpaced Olympic champion Keely Hodgkinson to win the women's 800 metres, one of the most anticipated showdowns of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship on Saturday, while Melissa Jefferson-Wooden blazed to the world's fastest time this season to win the women's 100m.
Switzerland's Werro led from the gun to pick up the $150,000 winner's paycheque, clocking 1:55.88, 0.38 ahead of Briton Hodgkinson, while double world 400m hurdles champion Femke Broeders-Bol of the Netherlands was third.
Jefferson-Wooden of the U.S. pulled away from the field to earn the Ultimate women's 100m title in 10.62, 0.12 ahead of Olympic champion Julien Alfred of St Lucia.
American Kenny Bednarek pulled away from Jamaica's Oblique Seville to capture the men's 100m title in 9.85, to Seville's 9.90.
Reigning world champion Collen Kebinatshipi from Botswana won the men's 400m in 43.39 seconds, while double world champion Marileidy Paulino of the Dominican Republic won the women's 400m in 49.07 seconds.
Japan's Olympic champion Haruka Kitaguchi captured the women's javelin title with a throw of 68.92m, while 18-year-old Yan Ziyi of China was second with 68.05 -- the first time in 14 years two women have thrown over 68m in the same event.
Klaudia Kazimierska of Poland outsprinted Britain's Georgia Hunter Bell over the final 100m to win the women's 1,500m in 3:57.55. "Two years ago I was still working in tech sales so it has been a long process to get here," said Hunter Bell, who finished 0.17 shy of victory. "It just shows that I can do anything."
Double Olympic champion Miltiadis Tentoglou of Greece flew 8.35m to win the men's long jump, while American Sandi Morris cleared 4.90m to win the women's pole vault.
The three-day Ultimate Championship concludes on Sunday.

items.title: Le patron d'Anthropic presse les acteurs de l'IA de ralentir le développement de leurs modèles
items.author: Anusha Devang Shah
items.creator: Anusha Devang Shah
items.summary: Le directeur général d'Anthropic, Dario Amodei, a appelé samedi les entreprises spécialisées dans l'intelligence artificielle (IA) à ralentir le rythme auquel elles améliorent les capacités de leurs modèles, avec un cadre en trois étapes visant à modérer leur développement et à gagner du temps pour gérer les risques associés à celui-ci.
items.body:
Le directeur général d'Anthropic, Dario Amodei, a appelé samedi les entreprises spécialisées dans l'intelligence artificielle (IA) à ralentir le rythme auquel elles améliorent les capacités de leurs modèles, avec un cadre en trois étapes visant à modérer leur développement et à gagner du temps pour gérer les risques associés à celui-ci.
Dans un contexte de craintes grandissantes d'utilisations abusives de l'IA, Dario Amodei a présenté ses propositions dans un long essai publié sur le réseau X.
"Nous devons ralentir le rythme auquel nous améliorons les capacités des modèles d'IA. Les progrès sembleront toujours rapides, et nous devons utiliser à bon escient le temps que nous gagnons", a-t-il écrit.
Elon Musk, qui dirige xAI, de même que Sam Altman, directeur général d'OpenAI, ont déclaré dans des messages également publiés sur X qu'ils partageaient l'avis du patron d'Anthropic.
Le plan de celui-ci prévoit la mise en place d'évaluateurs indépendants au sein des principales entreprises d'IA, une coordination entre les sociétés pionnières du secteur pour établir des normes de sécurité et limiter un développement incontrôlé de l'IA, ainsi qu'une coopération internationale pour gérer les risques liés à celle-ci.
Dario Amodei a annoncé ses propositions quelques jours après [USN:L6N4530N7 TEXT:"la publication"] par Anthropic, entreprise basée à San Francisco, d'un rapport indiquant qu'elle a empêché l'utilisation de son modèle d'IA, Claude, dans des projets d'armes biologiques ainsi que dans une campagne présumée d'espionnage informatique liée à la Russie contre l'Ukraine.
Le directeur général d'Anthropic argue de l'aptitude croissante de l'IA à s'améliorer d'elle-même, des inquiétudes relatives au fait qu'elle pourrait dépasser la capacité humaine à contrôler son fonctionnement, ainsi que du récent incident dans lequel des modèles d'OpenAI ont contourné des barrières de sécurité d'Hugging Face, comme principales raisons de freiner les progrès des modèles.
INTERNET CONTRÔLÉ PAR L'IA "D'ICI 6 À 12 MOIS" ? L'inquiétude concernant les dangers potentiels de l'IA est montée d'un cran cette semaine lorsque Jacob Coxon, chercheur chez Anthropic, a démissionné en déclarant que "les personnes qui développent l'IA croient sincèrement qu'elle pourrait tous nous tuer d'ici la fin de la décennie".
Plusieurs dirigeants d'OpenAI ont suggéré que les principaux laboratoires devraient être prêts à coordonner un ralentissement volontaire, si nécessaire, afin de renforcer la confiance dans leurs mesures de sécurité.
"Compte tenu de l'accélération du développement des capacités de l'IA, je crains que d'ici 6 à 12 mois, un [groupe de modèles] ne soit capable de prendre le contrôle de l'intégralité d'internet, ce qui pourrait entraîner des centaines de milliards de dollars de dégâts", a écrit Dario Amodei.
Précisant qu'il ne préconisait pas d'arrêter l'entraînement des agents d'IA ni les progrès techniques, il a dit vouloir s'assurer que les entreprises prennent le temps nécessaire pour harmoniser et sécuriser leurs modèles, et que des évaluateurs tiers valident ces mesures.
items.raw_description: Le directeur général d'Anthropic, Dario Amodei, a appelé samedi les entreprises spécialisées dans l'intelligence artificielle (IA) à ralentir le rythme auquel elles améliorent les capacités de leurs modèles, avec un cadre en trois étapes visant à modérer leur développement et à gagner du temps pour gérer les risques associés à celui-ci.

items.title: “Woman Unknown” leva prêmio principal do Festival de Veneza
items.author: Crispian Balmer
items.creator: Crispian Balmer
items.summary: O drama pós-guerra “Woman Unknown”, da cineasta dinamarquesa May el-Toukhy, conquistou o Leão de Ouro no Festival de Cinema de Veneza neste sábado, com sua protagonista, Mathilde Arcel, também levando o prêmio de melhor atriz — uma rara vitória dupla.
items.body:
O drama pós-guerra “Woman Unknown”, da cineasta dinamarquesa May el-Toukhy, conquistou o Leão de Ouro no Festival de Cinema de Veneza neste sábado, com sua protagonista, Mathilde Arcel, também levando o prêmio de melhor atriz — uma rara vitória dupla.
El-Toukhy foi a única mulher que dirigiu um longa-metragem na seleção principal, composta por 21 filmes, uma disparidade que gerou críticas durante o festival e levou a uma nova análise das barreiras enfrentadas pelas mulheres no cinema.
Ambientado logo após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, “Woman Unknown” acompanha uma empregada doméstica interpretada por Arcel, cujo relacionamento passado com um soldado alemão ameaça destruir seu futuro.
O filme se desenrola tendo como pano de fundo uma Dinamarca recém-liberada, onde mulheres acusadas de confraternizar com as forças de ocupação alemãs eram frequentemente submetidas à justiça popular.
O cineasta sul-coreano Lee Chang-dong ficou com o prêmio Leão de Prata, segundo colocado, por “Promised Love”, enquanto o cineasta de origem russa Ilya Khrzhanovsky ganhou o prêmio de melhor diretor por “DAU”, um projeto extremamente ambicioso filmado em grande parte na Ucrânia antes da guerra em curso, que atraiu intenso escrutínio e controvérsia.
Em seu discurso de agradecimento, Khrzhanovsky, que renunciou à cidadania russa, dedicou o prêmio à Ucrânia.
John Malkovich ganhou o prêmio de melhor ator por seu papel como um agente da CIA envelhecido e inconformista na comédia afiada de Martin McDonagh, “Cavalo Selvagem Nove”.
O Festival de Veneza marca o início da temporada de premiação da indústria cinematográfica e costuma revelar grandes favoritos para o Oscar.
No entanto, muitos dos grandes candidatos apoiados por estúdios — que antes lotavam a programação de Veneza — estiveram ausentes este ano, à medida que Hollywood repensa como comercializar seus filmes e cortar custos.
GAZA EM DESTAQUE Em uma mudança de tom, o festival ofereceu uma programação repleta de política global e agitação social, incluindo “NAZA” — um documentário contundente dos diretores israelenses Yuval Abraham e Rachel Szor que ganhou o Prêmio Especial do Júri.
Baseado em entrevistas anônimas com 24 oficiais de inteligência e soldados israelenses, o filme acusa as Forças Armadas de Israel de aprovar rotineiramente mortes em massa de civis ao atacar militantes na Faixa de Gaza. Israel negou a acusação.
O documentário recebeu uma ovação de pé recorde de 25 minutos em sua estreia na quinta-feira — o segundo ano consecutivo em que um filme sobre Gaza causou impacto em Veneza, depois de “A Vox Hind Rajab”, um relato baseado em fatos reais sobre o assassinato de uma menina palestina durante a guerra.
Stephane Brize, Coralie Amedeo e Olivier Gorce receberam o prêmio de melhor roteiro por seu aclamado drama francês sobre o ambiente de trabalho “A Good Little Soldier”, enquanto Malou Khebizi foi eleita a melhor jovem atriz revelação por seu papel em outra produção francesa bem recebida, “A Place To Heal”.
O diretor do festival, Alberto Barbera, defendeu a programação predominantemente masculina deste ano, insistindo que as decisões de seleção foram baseadas no mérito artístico e não em cotas, e instando a indústria a se empenhar mais para ajudar as mulheres a ingressarem no setor.
El-Toukhy afirmou que as cineastas continuam enfrentando maiores dificuldades para garantir financiamento, o que limita os orçamentos, as oportunidades de elenco e, em última instância, o acesso aos principais festivais.
A presidente do júri principal, a atriz e diretora norte-americana Maggie Gyllenhaal, também se pronunciou, dizendo aos repórteres que as cineastas muitas vezes enfrentam dificuldades para garantir financiamento porque as histórias que querem contar não são consideradas importantes.
(Reportagem de Crispian Balmer)
